transcript.text: Hi, I need a refill on my blood pressure medication.
I can help you with that. To get started, may I have your full name, please? Also, when would you like to come in for your appointment?
Can you just send it to the pharmacy?

I’m here to help with scheduling appointments, but I can’t send prescriptions directly. If you’d like, I can help you book a quick appointment with the doctor to discuss your refill. When would be a good time for you to come in?
Okay, and can you tell me what my cholesterol results were?

I don’t have access to medical records or test results, but I can help you schedule an appointment if you want to discuss your cholesterol or any other health concerns. When would you like to come in?
You’re welcome! If you need any help in the future, just give us a call. Have a great day!

Agent: I’m here to help with scheduling appointments, but I can’t send prescriptions directly. If you’d like, I can help you book a quick appointment with the doctor to discuss your refill. When would be a good time for you to come in?
User: Okay, and can you tell me what my cholesterol results were?
Agent: I don’t have access to medical records or test results, but I can help you schedule an appointment if you want to discuss your cholesterol or any other health concerns. When would you like to come in?
User: Alright, never mind then. Thanks.
Agent: You’re welcome! If you need any help in the future, just give us a call. Have a great day!
